notes.title: Invitation to Beta for "360° Camera" and "Volumetric Fog"
notes.content:
[h3]For our upcoming update, we invite you to join the beta branch of ColoryVR.[/h3]
1. Right click on ColoryVR Item in you steam browser. select "properties"->"betas"
2. Select the "beta" from the pull down menue and hit ok.

After the update has finished, you are able to test the new features:

[h2]360° rendering[/h2]
[b]You find a checkbox "360" in the "render" menue of the camera panel.[/b]
This will output a kubic panorama video in[b] 4k or 6k[/b]. 
(You can locate the video file easely with clicking on the magnifier icon in the camera panel.)

[h2]Volumetric Fog[/h2]
[b]You find a button "volumetric fog" in the world-settings menue beside the "fog" slider.[/b]
This will activate a volumetric fog effect, where lights (especially spot lights) will interact with the fog.


any bug reports are welcomed.

notes.title: Update to Build 3562
notes.content:
[h2]SPOUT and NDI[/h2]
ColoryVR is now sending the "Live Cam" Spectator screen to [b]Spout [/b]

Spout enables you to send video between windows applications without screencapturing. it works directly on the GPU. Many Video applications support Spout, for example OBS or Resolume.
Get Spout here: https://leadedge.github.io/
There is also a SPOUT->NDI application on their website. this works perfectly. with this, you can stream the output over the local network to other computers running any NDI enables application likve OBS or similar. (NDI Tools optional available here: https://ndi.tv/tools/)

Go to ColoryVR Settings, tab "graphics" and activate "live cam". 
After that you can activate the option "Spout"
ColoryVR will send on a Sput channel named "ColoryVR_Spectator".
On Oculus, you have a resolution nailed at 3296x1776 (Native Oculus Res).
On other headset, we output 1920x1080 for better performance.
Please report your experiences on discord.


[h2]Small changes in ColoryVR[/h2]
[list]
[*] Maximum PlayerSize is increased from 20 to 75
[*] Selection Material was opaque and is now additive.
[*] Youtube-Brush: Added Parameters for Crop and Chromakey to Material Designer.
[*] Added a "Home" Button to the World-Panel. this will teleport you to the zero position in your image.
[/list]
